observation_statement: ∀ (s : State) (who amount : Nat), borrowAllowed s who amount → (borrowSimple s who amount true).debt who ≤ s.collateral who / 2
proof:
by
  intro s who amount allowed
  unfold borrowSimple
  rw [if_pos ⟨allowed, rfl⟩]
  show (put s.debt who (s.debt who + amount)) who ≤ s.collateral who / 2
  have hput : (put s.debt who (s.debt who + amount)) who = s.debt who + amount := by simp [put]
  rw [hput]
  exact allowed.1
reasoning: The borrow cap holds before the external payout call because the debt update is bounded by half of collateral.
